ev.q: During September 30, 2004–September 30, 2022, the number of persons with HIV infection on PEPFAR-supported ART increased 4,884%
the viral load suppression rate increased from 91% (479,915 of 526,936) to 94%
the viral load suppression rate increased from 91% (479,915 of 526,936) to 94%
an estimated 491,345 HIV infections were averted
In September 2022, viral load suppression rates were higher among adults (95% [1,116,888 of 1,179,551]) than among children
Sustained efforts substantially expanded ART in Uganda (4,884% increase)
the number of viral load tests conducted increased 130%, from 526,936 to 1,213,707

methods_quotes.q: the number of persons with HIV infection on ART were interpolated using program data from 2003
The proxy MTCT rate was calculated as the number of HIV-exposed infants during pregnancy or the breastfeeding period
the suppression rate was calculated as the number of persons with HIV infection with viral load suppression
Both models use national program statistics, survey and surveillance data, and study-derived epidemiologic parameters to calibrate structured models of HIV transmission
